<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="מנחם אב_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518919889_theRebbe_263" batchId="meluket-_D7_9E_D7_A0_D7_97_D7_9D_20_D7_90_D7_91_meluket__BH_POST_1766518919889_theRebbe_263__p003">
  <section v="6">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains the two aspects of the superiority of baalei teshuvah over completely righteous tzaddikim: revealing the soul's essential connection and creating a new level through transforming sins into merits.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">4)</t>
    <t s="1">And this will be understood based on what is explained elsewhere,</t>
    <t s="2">that regarding the superiority of baalei teshuvah over completely righteous tzaddikim,</t>
    <t s="3">there are two matters.</t>
    <t s="4">First,</t>
    <t s="5">that through teshuvah the powerful connection of his soul with the Holy One, blessed be He, is revealed,</t>
    <t s="6">so that even the separation caused by sins</t>
    <t s="7">("Your iniquities separate")</t>
    <t s="8">is only in the revelations and not in the essence of the soul,</t>
    <t s="9">therefore,</t>
    <t s="10">even after sins, etc.,</t>
    <t s="11">in one moment and in an instant,</t>
    <t s="12">he becomes a completely righteous person.</t>
    <t s="13">For this elevation in the baal teshuvah relative to the tzaddik is that in the baal teshuvah the powerful connection in the soul that exists</t>
    <t s="14">(in concealment)</t>
    <t s="15">also in the tzaddik is revealed.</t>
    <t s="16">And second,</t>
    <t s="17">that through teshuvah in a manner that intentional sins are transformed into merits,</t>
    <t s="18">a new elevation is added in him that does not exist in tzaddikim even in concealment,</t>
    <t s="19">as is known</t>
    <t s="20">that these merits are more elevated than the merits of tzaddikim.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="7">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section parallels the two aspects of teshuvah to the soul's descent into a body, explaining how the concealment reveals hidden powers and the work below creates a new reality of refinement.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And similarly regarding the elevation of teshuvah that occurs in the soul through its descent below,</t>
    <t s="1">and as is known</t>
    <t s="2">that the souls before their descent below are in the category of completely righteous tzaddikim, and the advantage that is made in them through their descent into a body is that they become in the category of baalei teshuvah,</t>
    <t s="3">which has an analogy to the two matters mentioned above.</t>
    <t s="4">First,</t>
    <t s="5">that through the body and the animal soul concealing and hiding the light of the soul,</t>
    <t s="6">thereby its hidden powers are aroused,</t>
    <t s="7">even to the essential powers that are above even the hidden powers.</t>
    <t s="8">And second,</t>
    <t s="9">that through the work of the soul below a new matter is made,</t>
    <t s="10">the clarification and refinement of the body and the animal soul and its portion in the world.</t>
    <t s="11">For this matter, since it is a renewal</t>
    <t s="12">(and not a revelation of the concealed)</t>
    <t s="13">is more elevated than the revelation of the hidden powers of the soul</t>
    <t s="14">[in addition that specifically through this</t>
    <t s="15">(clarification and refinement of the body, etc.)</t>
    <t s="16">the intention of the soul's descent below and of a dwelling place in the lower realms is completed].</t>
    <t s="17">And since also this elevation</t>
    <t s="18">(the novelty of refining the body and the animal soul and its portion in the world)</t>
    <t s="19">is accomplished through the work of the soul,</t>
    <t s="20">therefore,</t>
    <t s="21">also the ascent of the soul through its work below is</t>
    <t s="22">(not only that its inner and essential powers are revealed,</t>
    <t s="23">but rather)</t>
    <t s="24">in a manner of renewal.</t>
    <t s="25">And as explained in many places</t>
    <t s="26">regarding the advantage of the love of G-d that the soul produces in the animal soul over the love of the G-dly soul,</t>
    <t s="27">that the love of the G-dly soul,</t>
    <t s="28">is in the category of existence.</t>
    <t s="29">For even the love of the soul, that it desires to cleave to its root and source, even though it be naught and nothing and become nullified there in existence entirely,</t>
    <t s="30">nevertheless,</t>
    <t s="31">since this desire is from its nature,</t>
    <t s="32">behold through this desire its essential form is not nullified.</t>
    <t s="33">But not so the love of the animal soul,</t>
    <t s="34">since by its nature it is drawn to physical matters,</t>
    <t s="35">and love for G-dliness is the opposite of its nature,</t>
    <t s="36">behold through the love for G-dliness</t>
    <t s="37">(that was renewed in it through the work of the G-dly soul),</t>
    <t s="38">its form is destroyed and it is nullified entirely,</t>
    <t s="39">a nullification of existence.</t>
    <t s="40">And this also effects the nullification of the form of the G-dly soul,</t>
    <t s="41">so that its love will be in the category of nullification,</t>
    <t s="42">not from the nature and existence of the lover</t>
    <t s="43">(soul),</t>
    <t s="44">but rather,</t>
    <t s="45">love from the aspect of the Beloved</t>
    <t s="46">(G-dliness).</t>
    <t s="47">And similarly regarding the clarification and refinement of his portion in the world,</t>
    <t s="48">for since this effects that the matters of the world become vessels for G-dliness,</t>
    <t s="49">it is a matter of renewal,</t>
    <t s="50">the opposite of the nature of the world, from the term concealment and hiding,</t>
    <t s="51">behold this matter</t>
    <t s="52">(that the world becomes a vessel for G-dliness)</t>
    <t s="53">is not from the aspect of the world but rather from the aspect of G-dliness,</t>
    <t s="54">from the aspect that His oneness, blessed be He, has no limitation,</t>
    <t s="55">so that even the existence of the world is unified with Him, blessed be He,</t>
    <t s="56">and through this it is also effected in the person</t>
    <t s="57">(who effected the clarification and refinement of his portion in the world)</t>
    <t s="58">that his service of his Master will be in ultimate nullification,</t>
    <t s="59">not only from the aspect of the person's existence but from the aspect of G-dliness.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="8">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains the great elevation of actual mesirus nefesh, which creates a new reality in the animal soul and leads to a higher level of nullification in the G-dly soul.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">5)</t>
    <t s="1">And based on the above, we can also explain the greatness of the elevation of those who merited actual mesirus nefesh in practice for the sanctification of G-d's name</t>
    <t s="2">[and to note from the famous "in public" that my master, my father, the Baal HaHilula was arrested and exiled to a remote town in a distant country for his work in strengthening and spreading Judaism and suffered there</t>
    <t s="3">(during the arrest and afterwards while in exile)</t>
    <t s="4">severe sufferings and afflictions, etc., etc.,</t>
    <t s="5">to the point that these sufferings and afflictions caused</t>
    <t s="6">(according to nature)</t>
    <t s="7">that he passed away before his time],</t>
    <t s="8">for at first glance it is perplexing,</t>
    <t s="9">behold the matter of mesirus nefesh is a natural thing for every Jew, that it is absolutely impossible to deny the One G-d, and he is prepared to give his life for this and suffers afflictions, etc.</t>
    <t s="10">(and that they did not have actual mesirus nefesh,</t>
    <t s="11">is because they were not required for it),</t>
    <t s="12">and what is the great elevation of those who had actual mesirus nefesh?</t>
    <t s="13">And even more perplexing is what Rabbi Akiva said,</t>
    <t s="14">"All my days I was distressed over this verse,</t>
    <t s="15">'with all your soul,' etc., when will it come to my hand and I will fulfill it,"</t>
    <t s="16">for at first glance,</t>
    <t s="17">this very thing, that all his days he actually yearned to fulfill this verse,</t>
    <t s="18">is a revelation of his power of mesirus nefesh that shone within him,</t>
    <t s="19">and what was so lacking in his matter of mesirus nefesh</t>
    <t s="20">(as long as it did not come to actual practice,</t>
    <t s="21">due to a cause not dependent on him)</t>
    <t s="22">that he was distressed over it?</t>
    <t s="23">And the explanation can be said,</t>
    <t s="24">that this readiness of every Jew to give his life rather than deny G-d, heaven forbid, is from the aspect of the soul,</t>
    <t s="25">and even when he arouses his power of mesirus nefesh in revelation</t>
    <t s="26">(that if he would need to, heaven forbid,</t>
    <t s="27">he would actually give his life),</t>
    <t s="28">it is that the power of mesirus nefesh of the soul comes into revelation.</t>
    <t s="29">And the mesirus nefesh of the soul is from its nature,</t>
    <t s="30">and there is no novelty in this.</t>
    <t s="31">But not so in actual mesirus nefesh in practice, a matter that did not exist beforehand is renewed.</t>
    <t s="32">For in addition to this coming about through the concealment, hiding, and opposition of those who force him to deny G-d, heaven forbid,</t>
    <t s="33">and through his giving his life and agreeing to suffer from them he extracts the sparks that are in them and elevates them to holiness,</t>
    <t s="34">this matter</t>
    <t s="35">(the elevation of the sparks that fell so low)</t>
    <t s="36">is a novelty,</t>
    <t s="37">behold the novelty in actual mesirus nefesh is also regarding the person who stands in mesirus nefesh,</t>
    <t s="38">for when he gives his life in actual practice,</t>
    <t s="39">then,</t>
    <t s="40">the mesirus nefesh is</t>
    <t s="41">(also)</t>
    <t s="42">in the animal soul.</t>
    <t s="43">For not only is there no hindrance from it to mesirus nefesh, but it actually desires to give its life in practice.</t>
    <t s="44">And since the animal soul</t>
    <t s="45">(from its own perspective)</t>
    <t s="46">desires to live,</t>
    <t s="47">behold the mesirus nefesh that is effected in it</t>
    <t s="48">(by the G-dly soul)</t>
    <t s="49">is a renewal and the opposite of its nature.</t>
    <t s="50">And this is the greatness of the elevation that is specifically in actual mesirus nefesh in practice,</t>
    <t s="51">for the mesirus nefesh that is from the aspect of the soul,</t>
    <t s="52">since it is from its nature,</t>
    <t s="53">it is in the category of existence,</t>
    <t s="54">but not so the mesirus nefesh in practice,</t>
    <t s="55">since it is the opposite of the nature of the animal soul,</t>
    <t s="56">behold through its mesirus nefesh it is nullified from its existence,</t>
    <t s="57">and through this an elevation is also made in the G-dly soul</t>
    <t s="58">(that effected the mesirus nefesh in the animal soul),</t>
    <t s="59">so that also its mesirus nefesh is in the category of nullification.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
